name: dispatchalt
algorithm: dispatch's loop with the target alternating (objs[i & 1]), so the indirect branch is predicted and the per-call overhead shows; the same data structures, argument stream and wrapping arithmetic (README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: the algorithm already uses the wrapping operators; there is no checked arithmetic to remove

no_counts: B24: no data-dependent control flow; the target is i & 1 and the trip count is n, and the checksum is exact wrapping integer arithmetic over the whole sequence
notes: The columns of ../dispatch (the same pairs and the same Mk StepDyn), with the index i & 1 (review finding DYN-7: the random target's mispredicts, about the same in every column, hide the adapter's key compare and frame).
Written by the std-dyn lane (status/std-dyn.md). Checksums from a Go reference of the pseudo-code (seed 1), checked against every column by tools/bench verify.
